'''Skunnt''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan. [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] and his [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] brother [[Gorc]] were members of the Skunnt clan.
